key_insight: For arrangements of at most 16 complex projective lines, the intersection lattice determines the generic splitting type of the logarithmic bundle.
engineering_relevance: For computational algebra systems, this makes finite incidence data sufficient to determine a geometric bundle invariant within the proven range.
method: Reduce to critical arrangements with 2s+3 lines and minimal Jacobian syzygy degree s.
Bound the derivation’s zero scheme using inflection-polynomial factorization, Chern classes, and Riccati equations.
Combine multirestriction and computer-algebra checks with exhaustive candidate-lattice enumeration.
evidence_signal: The proof includes exhaustive enumeration of 26,265,318 candidate lattices satisfying Bojanowski’s inequality with zero-scheme length 2 or 3.
watch_item: The full splitting-type result is limited to at most 16 lines; extensions to arbitrary line counts require additional hypotheses.
paper_title: The generic splitting type of the logarithmic bundle of an arrangement of at most sixteen lines is combinatorial
